cards.fact: Push places a new element on top of the stack in O(1) time. The stack only ever grows or shrinks from one end — the top.
Pop removes and returns the top element, also O(1). Whatever was pushed most recently comes off first.
Peek (or top) reads the top element without changing the stack — useful for checking what would be popped next.
The defining rule of a stack: the last item you added is always the first one to come out. Think undo history, browser back, or a call stack.
